title: Animation KB record
description: One record per selectable animation. Spec v1.1 §6.1 — the field set is a contract: no renames, no invented keys. `additionalProperties: false` is what enforces that. Semantic fields (description, tags, intents, valence, energy) must be present from B1 but may be empty drafts; B2 fills them and `validate-manifest.mjs --level semantic` is what requires them to be real.

id.description: Stable, unique, derived from the asset path so a re-harvest reproduces it exactly.

file.description: Repo-relative path. Required for vrma, bvh and pose; forbidden for procedural.

behaviorRef.description: An AnimationPresets emotion id. Required for procedural; forbidden otherwise.

description.description: action + body focus + tempo + emotion. Empty until B2.

rootMotion.description: Horizontal travel in body heights — avatar-independent, so it survives retargeting.

meanJointVel.description: Mean absolute joint angular velocity, rad/s. The energy proxy of §5.P0.

retarget.description: Why this clip needs care on a VRM rig. Present when quality is experimental.
